annotations.title: Get a payment link for a brand plan

description: Create a secure Stripe payment link for an a-un brand plan: brand (US$29/month: monthly agent check against 3 competitors, alerts, verified brand credential), fix (US$169 one-time: a-un makes the site agent-ready) or agency (US$109/month, 5 brands). Use when the brand owner wants to buy, usually after check_brand_agent_readiness. Give the link to the owner: they pay by card on Stripe, with tax and tax ID handled there. This tool never charges anyone.

currency.description: Optional. mxn for Mexican brands (prices plus VAT). Omit to let Stripe pick from the payer's location.

domain.description: The brand's domain, e.g. yourbrand.com, so a-un knows which site to work on.

lang.description: Language of the payment page. Default en.

plan.description: brand (monthly), fix (one-time) or agency (monthly, up to 5 brands).

name: get_brand_plan_checkout
title: Get a payment link for a brand plan
